body.statement: Fix \(\mathcal A\) and condition on \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}(H,L,\mathcal A,X,Y,\gamma,x,y)=\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\). For one stationary trajectory in \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\), geometric beta mixing and boundedness of the indicators of the finitely many returned cylinders \(C_{\mathcal A,j}\) imply the moment and mixing hypotheses used for Newey--West HAC consistency. With modified Bartlett weights \(1-k/(h_T+1)\), \(h_T\to\infty\), and \(h_T=o(T^{1/4})\), \(\widehat\Omega_F\overset p\to\Omega_F\), \(\sqrt T(\widehat\theta_F-\theta_M(y;x))\Rightarrow N(0,v_F)\), \(\widehat v_F\overset p\to v_F\), and \(P_M\{\theta_M(y;x)\in[\widehat\theta_F\pm z_{1-\alpha/2}\sqrt{\widehat v_F/T}]\}\to1-\alpha\). The limit is invariant under algebraically equivalent expressions in \(\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) after redundant simplex coordinates are removed.
body.justification: A graphically identified cylinder functional becomes operational only with dependence-aware single-trajectory uncertainty quantification.
body.gap: Bhattacharya--Nabi--Shpitser develop hidden-graph influence-function estimators for independent samples, while Viviano--Bradic treat different time-series causal targets; neither gives a generic HAC delta method for overlapping cylinders emitted by a graph algorithm.
body.consumer: EasyRCA obtains confidence intervals for identified lag-specific transmission probabilities from one stationary regime.

obligation.what_is_open: Only the implication from a TID-SCG success token to the identifying equality needed to center the limit law at \(\theta_M(y;x)\).
obligation.obstruction: That implication is precisely accepting soundness of the unresolved dichotomy. A syntactic \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\) condition alone does not entail \(F(p_F)=\theta_M(y;x)\) from any established frozen definition or result.
obligation.attempted: I proved the complete statistical theorem directly from bounded finite-window indicators and geometric absolute regularity, including the mixing CLT, HAC consistency, empirical-denominator event, delta method, Wald coverage, and simplex-coordinate invariance.
obligation.partial_result: The entire statistical claim, including the overlapping-window central limit theorem, Bartlett HAC consistency, delta method, studentization, and representation invariance, is proved in \(\mathrm{lem:valid\text{-}cylinder\text{-}hac\text{-}delta}\) under the explicit identifying equality \(F(p_F)=\theta_M(y;x)\).  To recover the target exactly, one still needs the unproved implication \(\operatorname{TID\text{-}SCG}=\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F)\Rightarrow F(p_F)=\theta_M(y;x)\) from \(\mathrm{thm:tid\text{-}dichotomy}\).
